skill.name: dev-performance-lod-systems
skill.description: Level of Detail (LOD) techniques for R3F. Use when complex models cause FPS drops.

generated_query: I'm building a large forest scene in React Three Fiber with hundreds of detailed tree models. On mobile devices, the frame rate drops noticeably when the camera pulls back. I need to implement a level of detail system so that trees farther from the camera use simpler geometry or billboards. I have three GLTF versions of the tree: a high-detail one (with bark texture, full foliage), a medium-detail one (simplified trunk, fewer polygons), and a low-detail one (a single merged cylinder mesh). I also have a billboard texture for very distant trees. How can I use the Detailed component from @react-three/drei to switch between these LOD levels? I want to set distances like 0-10m for high detail, 10-30m for medium, 30-60m for low, and beyond 60m for the billboard. Please show me the code for each LOD group and how to integrate them into the Detailed component. Also, if there's a way to automatically generate lower LODs from the high-detail model, that would be helpful.
